statements.status_notes: The affected module is linked only through the devfile-gem Go binary rebuilt in this image; backup-utility does not invoke it. GitHub Security Advisory GHSA for CVE-2026-85747 lists patched releases at distribution v3.1.2 on the github.com/distribution/distribution/v3 module path. Replacing the legacy github.com/docker/distribution v2.8.3 dependency with v3.1.2 breaks compilation because oras-go v1.2.5 and docker/cli v25 still import registry/client packages that v3 removed. Resolves when those dependencies can move to releases built against distribution v3.
